steps.action: Step 6: in Outbound email check the configuration source while email is unset
steps.expected: The relay form with SMTP server, Port, Connection security, Authentication, Sender name (optional), Sender email and Save relay; no Set up later; Continue unavailable
steps.actual: The step said "Set up outbound email to finish instance setup. OpenLaw uses it for invitations, sign-in links, and notifications." and showed the relay fields and Save relay; no Set up later or Send test email; Continue disabled.

steps.action: Step 6: Authentication Username and password asks for SMTP username and SMTP password; a URL in SMTP server is refused
steps.expected: Both fields show and are required; a URL host is not saved
steps.actual: With Username and password, SMTP username and SMTP password were required ([true,true]). SMTP server "https://mail.harbor.example" was not saved (source "unset"; messages "One or more request fields are invalid. | Set up outbound email to finish instance setup. OpenLaw uses it for invitations, sign-in links, and notifications.").

steps.action: Step 6: enter the relay and select Save relay; select Send test email and check the inbox
steps.expected: Relay saved; Continue available; the test email arrives with the organization name and logo in its header
steps.actual: Save relay showed "Relay saved. The next email this instance sends will use it."; Continue became available. Send test email showed "Test email sent to avery.morgan@harbor.example. Check your inbox." Mailpit received "OpenLaw test email"; its header named "Harbor Legal DOC-032" with the inline image org-logo@openlaw. Replace relay then opened an empty form (the saved credential cleared its draft); Keep current relay closed it.
